title: Fulfillment Exception Agent — JD Edwards EnterpriseOne
summary: Read-only fulfillment exception analysis using live sales-order, inventory, inbound-supply, item, and address-book evidence.

platform.product: Oracle AI Database Private Agent Factory

connectionContext: The REST source statically supplies JPS920, role *ALL, and device paf-jde-agent. Basic Auth remains environment-local.

memory.description: Stateless grounded analysis; Agent Memory is not required.

capabilities: Finds bounded sales-order backorder candidates and cross-checks line and header status.
Compares indicative inventory across branches and credible inbound purchase-order supply.
Produces an approval-ready recovery recommendation without changing JDE.
prerequisites: Private Agent Factory 26.7-compatible environment and an available LLM connection.
Network access from Agent Factory to a JD Edwards EnterpriseOne AIS server.
JDE Basic Auth user with read access to F4211, F4201, F41021, F4311, F4101, and F0101.

tools.name: F4211
tools.purpose: Find sales-order lines and fulfillment exceptions.

tools.name: F4201
tools.purpose: Get order header, customer, dates, and hold status.

tools.name: F41021
tools.purpose: Check item inventory by branch and location.

tools.name: F4311
tools.purpose: Find inbound purchase-order supply for an item.

tools.name: F0101
tools.purpose: Resolve customer or supplier address-book details.

safetyControls: The OpenAPI definition exposes GET operations only.
Queries are bounded to 50 rows unless the user asks for more.
Recommendations distinguish evidence, assumptions, verification, approval, and execution.
Live analyses end with: JDE changes made: none (read-only analysis).
setup: Create a REST API data source from assets/jde-fulfillment-openapi.json; verify the AIS URL and configure JDE Basic Auth.
Download and import the release PAF using the repository archive passphrase.

Select AIW26-PAF-HOL6004-BOO6096 on every Agent node. This OpenAI Compatible connection is configured on build.oracleagentfactory.com and is the required model for the final AI World lab instances. Configure that same model name in each destination; model definitions and credentials are not bundled.
Rebind the REST API Tools node to the new environment-local source.
This catalog now uses the editor-owned consolidation copy. Configure the documented memory mode manually; official archives do not carry memory switches or learned memories.

Read the numbered sticky notes from left to right. Agent Description provides workflow details and sample questions; use its expand control to read the full guide. The 2026-10-18 layout/model update preserves the workflow wiring and documented memory mode; the earlier validation record describes the original demo runs.

steps.speaker: User
steps.text: Find up to five sales order lines with backordered quantity and explain which one is the best recovery candidate.

steps.speaker: User
steps.text: Investigate sales order <number>. Show the exact line evidence, inventory by branch, credible inbound supply, and rank recovery options.

steps.speaker: User
steps.text: For item <item>, compare indicative availability across branches and identify relevant open inbound purchase-order lines. Do not make any JDE changes.

expectedOutcomes: Uses fully qualified JDE fields and does not invent business data.
Calls calculated balances indicative availability unless ATP is proven.
States what a human must verify or approve and performs no write-back.
